senses.zh: 频繁地，经常地；时常，屡次

ex.en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
ex.zh: 邻居经常给我们送来她园子里种的蔬菜。

ex.en: People who frequently use public transport may spend less on travel than those who drive daily.
ex.zh: 经常使用公共交通的人，出行开支可能低于每天开车的人。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。通常放实义动词前、be动词后，与often近义。

ex.en: My sister recited a short poem after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我妹妹背诵了一首短诗。

ex.en: Students who merely recite facts may struggle to apply their knowledge to unfamiliar problems.
ex.zh: 只会背诵事实的学生可能难以运用知识解决陌生的问题。

col: recite a list｜逐一念出清单
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。recite强调出声背诵；memorise强调记住。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 教育家；教育工作者；教师

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 磨光，擦亮；上光剂，擦亮剂；优雅，精良

ex.en: I polish my shoes before every important meeting.
ex.zh: 每次参加重要会议前，我都会把鞋擦亮。

ex.en: University students should learn to polish their writing by removing unnecessary words and organising arguments logically.
ex.zh: 大学生应学会通过删去多余词语和有条理地组织论点来润色文章。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。小写polish指擦亮；大写Polish指波兰的，读音不同。

ex.en: She reads poetry aloud while her tea cools.
ex.zh: 她一边等茶凉下来，一边朗读诗歌。

ex.en: Studying poetry encourages students to explore complex emotions and appreciate the expressive possibilities of language.
ex.zh: 学习诗歌能鼓励学生探索复杂情感，并欣赏语言丰富的表达潜力。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。poetry不可数；一首诗用a poem，不用a poetry。

senses.zh: 构成；写作；使平静；排…的版

ex.en: She composed a short tune on her old piano.
ex.zh: 她用自己的旧钢琴创作了一段短曲。

ex.en: Students who compose their own music can develop creativity while gaining a deeper understanding of musical structure.
ex.zh: 自己作曲的学生既能培养创造力，也能加深对音乐结构的理解。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。be composed of表示“由……组成”。

ex.en: Her clear prose makes this book easy to enjoy.
ex.zh: 她清晰流畅的文笔让这本书读起来轻松愉快。

ex.en: Reading well-crafted prose can help students develop a wider vocabulary and express complex ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 阅读精心写就的散文可以帮助学生扩大词汇量，更清晰地表达复杂观点。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。不可数；不限于文学散文，也包括小说等非韵文。

ex.en: My grandfather enjoys singing patriotic songs during national celebrations.
ex.zh: 祖父喜欢在全国性庆典期间唱爱国歌曲。

ex.en: Patriotic feeling can encourage community service, but it should not prevent citizens from questioning government policies.
ex.zh: 爱国情怀可以鼓励社区服务，但不应妨碍公民质疑政府政策。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。patriotic强调爱国，不必然含排斥他国之意。

ex.en: We acquired a secondhand table for our tiny kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们为狭小的厨房添置了一张二手桌子。

ex.en: Work placements allow students to acquire practical skills that are difficult to develop through classroom learning alone.
ex.zh: 实习让学生获得仅靠课堂学习难以培养的实用技能。

col: an acquired taste｜后天养成的喜好
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。比get正式；可接资产，也可接知识、技能。

ex.en: My neighbour willingly watered the plants while I was away.
ex.zh: 我不在家时，邻居欣然帮我给植物浇水。

ex.en: Residents are more likely to participate willingly in recycling schemes when collection services are convenient and reliable.
ex.zh: 当回收服务便利且可靠时，居民更可能自愿参与回收计划。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。强调自愿而非被迫；不等于单纯“开心地”。

ex.en: The poet read her latest work beside the fireplace.
ex.zh: 这位诗人在壁炉旁朗读了她的最新作品。

ex.en: A poet can challenge social attitudes by expressing familiar experiences in unexpected and emotionally powerful ways.
ex.zh: 诗人可以用出人意料且富有感染力的方式表达日常体验，从而挑战社会观念。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。poet指诗人，poem指一首诗，poetry统称诗歌。

ex.en: Volunteers brought food and medical aid to the village.
ex.zh: 志愿者为村子送来了食物和医疗援助。

ex.en: International aid can improve access to clean water, but lasting progress also requires investment in local infrastructure.
ex.zh: 国际援助可以改善清洁用水的获取条件，但持久进步还需要对当地基础设施进行投资。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。援助义通常不可数；辅助工具义可数，如a hearing aid。

ex.en: Our science experiment showed how roots grow towards water.
ex.zh: 我们的科学实验展示了植物根部如何朝水源生长。

ex.en: Schools should allow students to experiment with different materials before explaining the scientific principles involved.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生先尝试使用不同材料，再讲解其中的科学原理。

col: experiment with materials｜尝试使用各种材料
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。动词接with表示尝试；名词重音在第二音节。

senses.zh: 气体； 瓦斯；汽油；毒气

ex.en: We use gas to cook our meals at home.
ex.zh: 我们在家用燃气做饭。

ex.en: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires investment in cleaner energy and more efficient public transport systems.
ex.zh: 减少温室气体排放需要投资更清洁的能源和更高效的公共交通系统。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。泛指气体通常不可数；多种气体用gases。

senses.zh: 合成；混合；恶化，加重；和解，妥协

ex.en: Water is a compound made from hydrogen and oxygen.
ex.zh: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。

ex.en: Poor public transport can compound the difficulties faced by people seeking employment in rural areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通不便会加重农村地区求职者面临的困难。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

ex.en: The fridge was practically empty when we got home.
ex.zh: 我们到家时，冰箱几乎空了。

ex.en: Without reliable internet access, participating in online education is practically impossible for students in remote areas.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的互联网连接，偏远地区的学生几乎无法参与在线教育。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。常表示“几乎”，并不总等于“实际地”。

senses.zh: 实验的；根据实验的；试验性的

ex.en: We compared the experimental results over lunch today.
ex.zh: 今天午饭时，我们比较了实验结果。

ex.en: Experimental evidence suggests that improved classroom ventilation can help students maintain concentration during longer lessons.
ex.zh: 实验证据表明，改善教室通风有助于学生在较长的课堂中保持专注。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。experimental指实验的或试验性的，不是“有经验的”。

senses.zh: 以某种方法；莫名其妙地

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 腓肠，小腿；小牛；小牛皮；(鲸等大哺乳动物的)幼崽

ex.en: The calf stayed close to its mother in the field.
ex.zh: 那头小牛在田野里紧紧跟着妈妈。

ex.en: Farmers must provide each calf with adequate nutrition and shelter to support healthy growth.
ex.zh: 农民必须为每头小牛提供充足的营养和遮蔽场所，以支持其健康生长。

col: a newborn calf｜刚出生的小牛
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。复数为calves；字母l不发音。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 收集；收割；使…聚集；使…皱起

ex.en: We gathered fallen apples in a basket before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我们把掉落的苹果收进了篮子。

ex.en: Researchers gather information from local residents to understand how public transport affects access to employment.
ex.zh: 研究人员向当地居民收集信息，以了解公共交通如何影响就业机会的获取。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。I gather that...表示“我听说或推断……”。

senses.zh: 对…说甜言蜜语；加蜜使甜

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.
ex.zh: 本地蜂蜜生产能为农村带来收入，同时鼓励农民保护蜜蜂的栖息地。

col: a spoonful of honey｜一勺蜂蜜
a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。表示蜂蜜时不可数；一罐蜂蜜说a jar of honey。

ex.en: We crossed the shallow stream on flat stones.
ex.zh: 我们踩着扁平的石头穿过了那条浅溪。

ex.en: Many students now stream educational videos at home, making reliable internet access increasingly important for learning.
ex.zh: 许多学生如今在家在线观看视频课程，因此可靠的网络连接对学习越来越重要。

col: a steady stream of visitors｜络绎不绝的访客
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。a stream of可指接连不断的人或事物。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

ex.en: A thin wire connects the lamp to its battery.
ex.zh: 一根细电线将灯与电池连接起来。

ex.en: Older buildings often need new electrical wire to meet modern safety standards and support increased energy use.
ex.zh: 老建筑往往需要更换电线，以符合现代安全标准并满足增长的用电需求。

col: wire up a house｜给房屋安装电线
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。wire可指单根金属丝；cable通常更粗或由多股组成。

senses.zh: 不守规矩的；任性的；难驾驭的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

ex.en: A grey donkey carried baskets along the narrow mountain path.
ex.zh: 一头灰驴驮着篮子走在狭窄的山路上。

ex.en: In some rural communities, donkeys remain important for transporting goods where roads are unsuitable for vehicles.
ex.zh: 在一些乡村社区，道路不适合车辆通行，驴仍是运输货物的重要工具。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。指动物时donkey最常用；用来称呼人有贬义。

senses.zh: 如灌木般长得低矮的；粗野的
以灌木装饰；使…精疲力竭

ex.en: A small bird was hiding in the rose bush.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟躲在玫瑰丛里。

ex.en: Planting native bushes in urban gardens can provide shelter and food for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地灌木，可以为当地野生动物提供庇护和食物。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。灌木是可数名词；the bush可指澳洲等地的荒野。

senses.zh: 罢免；剥夺…的席位；使失去资格；使从座位上（或马背上）摔下

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 使局促不安；使困窘；阻碍

ex.en: Please don't embarrass me by sharing that childhood photo.
ex.zh: 请别把那张童年照片给别人看，让我难为情。

ex.en: Correcting every mistake publicly can embarrass language learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 公开纠正每一个错误会让语言学习者感到尴尬，并使他们不愿参与课堂讨论。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事情令人尴尬用embarrassing。

ex.en: The nurse protected his dignity by closing the curtain.
ex.zh: 护士拉上帘子，维护了他的尊严。

ex.en: Care services should preserve the dignity of older people by respecting their privacy and personal choices.
ex.zh: 护理服务应尊重老年人的隐私和个人选择，维护他们的尊严。

col: preserve someone's dignity｜维护某人的尊严
treat someone with dignity｜有尊严地对待某人
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。通常不可数；with dignity可表示有尊严地。

senses.zh: 遭受，忍受；受痛苦；经验；受损害

ex.en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
ex.zh: 我不吃午饭时就会头痛。

ex.en: Small businesses often suffer financial losses when major roadworks prevent customers from reaching their premises.
ex.zh: 大型道路施工导致顾客无法到店时，小企业往往会遭受经济损失。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。

ex.en: It felt like fate when we met again.
ex.zh: 我们再次相遇时，感觉就像命中注定一样。

ex.en: The fate of many endangered species depends on whether governments protect their habitats from further destruction.
ex.zh: 许多濒危物种的命运取决于各国政府是否保护其栖息地免遭进一步破坏。

col: leave something to fate｜让某事听天由命
seal someone's fate｜决定某人的命运
suffer the same fate｜遭遇同样的结局
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。表示天意时通常不可数；a terrible fate指悲惨结局。

senses.zh: 失败的事实；击败的行为

ex.en: Our team defeated the champions in a thrilling final.
ex.zh: 我们队在一场激动人心的决赛中击败了冠军队。

ex.en: Although electoral defeat can damage a political party, it may also encourage necessary changes in leadership and policy.
ex.zh: 尽管选举失利会对政党造成打击，但也可能促使其对领导层和政策作出必要调整。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。defeat后接对手；win后接比赛、奖项等。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 拒付；使丢脸；拒绝承兑；不履行（诺言等）

ex.en: His cheating brought dishonour on the whole team.
ex.zh: 他的作弊行为使整个团队蒙羞。

ex.en: Companies that dishonour their commitments to workers risk losing public trust and damaging their long-term commercial prospects.
ex.zh: 不履行对员工承诺的公司可能失去公众信任，并损害其长期商业前景。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A。英式拼写为dishonour，美式为dishonor。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 轮流；轮流换班；轮流做某事

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 丢脸，失去自尊与别人的信任，失去尊严/影响力/名望; 坍台; 现眼; 面上无光

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 居里夫人；居礼夫人；玛丽·居里

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 查尔斯·达尔文；查理士·达尔文；查理斯达尔文

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 南非前总统曼德拉；纳尔逊·曼德拉；南非总统曼德拉

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 A

ex.en: The bells finally ceased ringing just before midnight.
ex.zh: 临近午夜时，钟声终于停了。

ex.en: Factories should cease discharging untreated wastewater into rivers to protect aquatic ecosystems and safeguard public health.
ex.zh: 工厂应停止向河流排放未经处理的废水，以保护水生生态系统和公众健康。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。较正式；后可接动名词或to do，均表示停止。

senses.zh: 靛蓝，靛蓝染料；靛蓝色；槐蓝属植物

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 用铅锤线测量(…的垂直度)；探测
（测水深或垂直面用的）铅垂线

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 过程，进行；方法，步骤；作用；程序；推移
经过特殊加工（或处理）的

ex.en: Making bread is a slow process, but I enjoy it.
ex.zh: 做面包是个缓慢的过程，但我很享受。

ex.en: The application process should be transparent so that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate.
ex.zh: 申请程序应当透明，以确保所有申请者都有平等的参与机会。

col: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。in the process of后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: The road was flooded; thus, we took another route.
ex.zh: 道路被淹了，因此我们改走了另一条路。

ex.en: Improved public transport can reduce dependence on private cars, thus lowering emissions and easing urban congestion.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以减少对私家车的依赖，从而降低排放并缓解城市拥堵。

col: thus reducing costs｜从而降低成本
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。thus是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个独立句。

senses.zh: 压；按；新闻；出版社； 印刷机

ex.en: Press this button to open the garage door.
ex.zh: 按这个按钮就能打开车库门。

ex.en: A free press helps citizens understand public affairs and holds those in power accountable.
ex.zh: 自由的新闻界帮助公民了解公共事务，并监督掌权者承担责任。

col: freedom of the press｜新闻自由
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。表示新闻界通常用the press；按按钮不用push down。

ex.en: The metal handle felt cold against my fingers.
ex.zh: 金属把手摸起来冰凉。

ex.en: Recycling metal reduces the demand for mining and can significantly lower energy consumption in manufacturing.
ex.zh: 回收金属可以减少采矿需求，并显著降低制造业的能源消耗。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 智慧，才智；明智；学识；至理名言

ex.en: My grandmother shared her wisdom while we cooked together.
ex.zh: 我和祖母一起做饭时，她分享了自己的人生智慧。

ex.en: The wisdom of expanding road networks is increasingly questioned as cities seek more sustainable transport solutions.
ex.zh: 随着城市寻求更可持续的交通方案，扩建道路网络是否明智越来越受到质疑。

col: question the wisdom of｜质疑……是否明智
the wisdom to do something｜做某事的智慧
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。不可数；knowledge重知识，wisdom重判断与运用。

ex.en: Our teacher conducted a quick survey about favourite snacks.
ex.zh: 老师就大家最喜欢的零食做了一次简短调查。

ex.en: Researchers should conduct thorough trials before recommending new treatments for widespread use in public hospitals.
ex.zh: 研究人员在建议公立医院广泛采用新疗法之前，应开展充分的试验。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

ex.en: The distance from our house to school is quite short.
ex.zh: 从我们家到学校的距离很短。

ex.en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
ex.zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

senses.zh: 波动；波浪；高潮；挥手示意；卷曲
卷（烫）发；向…挥手示意；使成波浪形
波动；起伏；挥手示意；摇动；呈波形

ex.en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
ex.zh: 一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。

ex.en: Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.
ex.zh: 沿海湿地能够吸收波浪能量，帮助保护附近居民区免受侵蚀和风暴破坏。

col: a wave of protests｜一波抗议
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。向某人挥手用wave at或wave to someone。

senses.zh: 运输；运费；四轮马车；举止；客车厢

ex.en: We found two empty seats in the last carriage.
ex.zh: 我们在最后一节车厢里找到了两个空座位。

ex.en: Adding an extra carriage to each train could reduce overcrowding and improve the daily experience of commuters.
ex.zh: 给每列火车加挂一节车厢，可以缓解拥挤并改善通勤者的日常乘车体验。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。火车车厢英式常用 carriage，美式常用 car。

ex.en: A pile of dirty dishes filled the sink.
ex.zh: 一堆脏餐具塞满了水槽。

ex.en: When waste collection services are inadequate, piles of rubbish can threaten public health in densely populated neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 垃圾清运服务不足时，成堆的垃圾可能威胁人口密集社区的公共卫生。

col: pile plates on a table｜把盘子堆在桌上
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。a pile of后接所堆之物；pile up表示积聚。

senses.zh: 龙；凶暴的人，凶恶的人；严厉而有警觉性的女人

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 行动；功绩；证书； 契据

ex.en: Helping our neighbour carry groceries was a kind deed.
ex.zh: 帮邻居提食品杂货是一桩善举。

ex.en: Recognising good deeds in schools can encourage students to take greater responsibility for their local communities.
ex.zh: 学校表彰善举，可以鼓励学生为所在社区承担更多责任。

col: in word and deed｜在言语和行动上
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。表示行为时较正式；房产契据常用复数deeds。

ex.en: My grandfather always said that patience was a virtue.
ex.zh: 我祖父总说，耐心是一种美德。

ex.en: One virtue of public transport is its ability to move large numbers of people using relatively little space.
ex.zh: 公共交通的一大优点是能利用相对较少的空间运送大量乘客。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。by virtue of意为由于或凭借，并非凭美德。

senses.zh: 深厚的；意义深远的；渊博的

ex.en: Meeting my childhood teacher filled me with profound gratitude.
ex.zh: 见到儿时的老师让我心中充满了深深的感激。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet has had a profound impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
ex.zh: 可靠的互联网接入对偏远社区的教育机会产生了深远影响。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。常修饰impact、change、understanding，不指物理深度。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 受过严格训练的人；良种动物
良种的；受过严格训练的；优秀的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

ex.en: We slowed our pace so Grandma could catch up.
ex.zh: 我们放慢脚步，好让奶奶跟上。

ex.en: The rapid pace of technological change requires workers to update their skills throughout their careers.
ex.zh: 技术变革的快速步伐要求劳动者在整个职业生涯中不断更新技能。

col: at your own pace｜按自己的节奏
the pace of change｜变化的速度
pace up and down｜来回踱步
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。按某种速度用at a ... pace；keep pace with指跟上。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

ex.en: Finishing my first long hike felt like a real achievement.
ex.zh: 完成第一次长途徒步让我觉得很有成就感。

ex.en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。

col: the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

ex.en: My grandfather carved a little bird from soft wood.
ex.zh: 我祖父用软木雕了一只小鸟。

ex.en: Local artisans carve traditional patterns into wooden furniture, preserving cultural skills while creating products for modern homes.
ex.zh: 当地工匠在木制家具上雕刻传统图案，既保留文化技艺，也为现代家庭制作产品。

col: carve out a career｜开创事业
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B。carve强调削刻成形；carve out a career指开创事业。

senses.zh: 腐烂的；堕落的；恶臭的；虚弱的；极坏的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 踮着脚(站立,走路等)；小心地；悄悄地；伸长脖子

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 在远方；远方的；在远处那边

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 凝视着远方；在远处；扔向远方

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 利用；利用某事物；利用好时间

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 存在于；主要在于；存在于…中

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 1 B

ex.en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
ex.zh: 一位志愿者帮我们把箱子搬上了楼。

ex.en: Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.
ex.zh: 大学可以通过提供灵活的时间安排和实际支持，鼓励学生参与社区志愿服务。

col: volunteer to help｜主动提出帮忙
volunteer for a charity｜为慈善机构做义工
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。自愿做某事用volunteer to do；voluntary是常用形容词。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A

ex.en: The rising river poses a threat to our village.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的河水对我们村庄构成威胁。

ex.en: Habitat destruction remains a major threat to biodiversity, particularly in regions experiencing rapid agricultural expansion.
ex.zh: 栖息地破坏仍是生物多样性面临的重大威胁，在农业迅速扩张的地区尤其如此。

col: pose a threat to｜对……构成威胁
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。名词用 threat；动词用 threaten。

ex.en: You can purchase fresh bread at the corner shop.
ex.zh: 你可以在街角的小店买到新鲜面包。

ex.en: Consumers should consider repair costs and energy efficiency before they purchase new household appliances.
ex.zh: 消费者购买新家电前，应考虑维修成本和能源效率。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。purchase比buy正式；名词可指购买行为或买到的东西。

senses.zh: 抓住；给…上领子；给…套上颈圈

ex.en: He straightened his shirt collar before the interview.
ex.zh: 面试前，他整理了一下衬衫衣领。

ex.en: A well-fitted collar allows owners to attach a lead and keep dogs under control in public spaces.
ex.zh: 合适的颈圈方便主人系上牵引绳，在公共场所管好狗。

col: turn up your collar｜竖起衣领
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。white-collar指白领的；blue-collar指蓝领的。

senses.zh: 赚，赚得；获得，挣得；使得到；博得

ex.en: She earns extra money by walking dogs after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后帮人遛狗，赚些零花钱。

ex.en: Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.
ex.zh: 企业可以通过如实报告环境影响并为自身错误负责来赢得公众信任。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。earn强调劳动或表现所得；win多指比赛获胜。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A

ex.en: We donate our spare blankets to the local shelter.
ex.zh: 我们把多余的毯子捐给当地的收容所。

ex.en: Businesses can reduce food waste by donating surplus products to charities that support vulnerable families.
ex.zh: 企业可以把剩余食品捐给帮助困难家庭的慈善机构，以减少食物浪费。

col: donate money to charity｜向慈善机构捐款
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。用donate something to someone，不用双宾语。

ex.en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
ex.zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。

ex.en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。

col: a wildlife reserve｜野生生物保护区
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

ex.en: He joined a local organisation that rescues injured birds.
ex.zh: 他加入了一个救助受伤鸟类的当地组织。

ex.en: Effective organisation of healthcare services can shorten waiting times and improve access for rural communities.
ex.zh: 有效组织医疗服务能够缩短等候时间，并改善农村社区获得医疗服务的机会。

col: require careful organisation｜需要周密安排
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。英式常写organisation，美式通常写organization。

ex.en: My twin and I share a love of swimming.
ex.zh: 我的双胞胎手足和我都喜欢游泳。

ex.en: Studies involving identical twins help researchers understand how genes and environment influence human development.
ex.zh: 涉及同卵双胞胎的研究有助于研究人员了解基因和环境如何影响人的发育。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。a twin指双胞胎中的一人；twins指两人。

senses.zh: 发射（导弹、火箭等）；发起，发动；使…下水
发射；发行，投放市场；下水；汽艇

ex.en: Our local bakery launched a new delivery service yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们当地的面包店昨天推出了新的送货服务。

ex.en: Schools should launch awareness campaigns to encourage healthier eating habits and reduce food waste among students.
ex.zh: 学校应开展宣传活动，鼓励学生养成更健康的饮食习惯，并减少食物浪费。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。推出产品、发起活动和发射卫星都可用launch。

ex.en: The library database helped me find a gardening book.
ex.zh: 图书馆的数据库帮我找到了一本园艺书。

ex.en: Hospitals need secure databases to protect patient records while allowing doctors to access essential information.
ex.zh: 医院需要安全的数据库来保护病历，同时让医生能够获取必要信息。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。可数名词；在数据库中通常用 in a database。

ex.en: We found shelter under a bridge during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，我们躲到一座桥下避雨。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide temporary shelter for residents whose homes have been damaged by floods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应为房屋遭洪水损坏的居民提供临时住所。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。表示庇护通常不可数；指具体避难所时可数。

ex.en: Our urban garden sits between two tall apartment buildings.
ex.zh: 我们的城市花园位于两栋高层公寓楼之间。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth can increase pressure on public transport, housing, and essential services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速发展可能加重公共交通、住房及基本服务的压力。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。urban指城镇的，rural指乡村的。

ex.en: The hotel agreed to my request for extra pillows.
ex.zh: 酒店答应了我多要几个枕头的请求。

ex.en: Residents can request detailed information about proposed developments before local authorities make their final planning decisions.
ex.zh: 在地方政府作出最终规划决定之前，居民可以要求获取拟建项目的详细信息。

col: a request for information｜索取信息的请求
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。名词接for；动词直接接宾语：request information。

senses.zh: 塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的

ex.en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
ex.zh: 这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。

ex.en: Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
ex.zh: 减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。
